skill.name: inbox-placement-monitor
skill.description: Use when the user asks to "track where my emails are actually landing after I send", "read my seed-list inbox vs spam vs promotions results", "trend my Gmail Postmaster / Microsoft SNDS reputation", or "did placement drop after my last send"; produces a per-provider inbox/spam/promotions placement read, a domain/IP reputation trend from Postmaster + SNDS, a send-over-send delta with named regressions, and a reusable SEND-S placement snapshot on your own exported telemetry. Not for the pre-send SPF/DKIM/DMARC auth pre-flight — use deliverability-qa; not for computing the EQS or running the vetoes — use email-quality-auditor. 邮件收件箱落点监测/收件箱vs垃圾邮件/Postmaster声誉趋势
skill.summary: Monitor post-send inbox placement and sender reputation across major mailbox providers.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, fixed documentation links, and homepage metadata. The skill does include an intentional live Resend command, and its save template lacks explicit filename sanitization guidance.

remediation.issue: The seed-send workflow can execute a connector with live external effects.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run as the default and require immediate user confirmation before --live. Validate the sender, recipients, subject, and campaign file before execution.

remediation.issue: The save filename includes a user-derived domain or topic.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize the value to a basename with an allowlist of letters, numbers, dots, and hyphens. Reject separators and parent-directory sequences.

content.user_title: Monitor Inbox Placement and Sender Reputation
content.value_statement: Post-send data is fragmented across seed tests and reputation dashboards. This skill combines those exports into provider-level placement trends and named regressions.
actual_capabilities: Reads inbox, spam, and promotions placement by mailbox provider from supplied seed-test results.
Summarizes Gmail domain and IP reputation, spam rates, and feedback-loop signals.
Summarizes Microsoft SNDS IP status, complaint trends, and spam-trap activity.
Compares current results with a prior send and names each regression with its magnitude.
Labels metrics by evidence type and produces a reusable SEND-S placement snapshot.
limitations: Requires user-provided seed-test, Gmail Postmaster, Microsoft SNDS, or ESP exports.
Cannot calculate send-over-send changes when no prior baseline is available.
Does not verify SPF, DKIM, or DMARC and does not compute the full email quality score.
Live seed sending requires a configured Resend connector and explicit user confirmation.

use_cases.title: Investigate Provider Placement
use_cases.description: Review a seed test to identify which mailbox providers placed a campaign in inbox, spam, or promotions.

use_cases.title: Track Campaign Regressions
use_cases.description: Compare recent sends and quantify changes in placement, complaints, and sender reputation.

use_cases.title: Report Client Reputation Trends
use_cases.description: Combine Postmaster and SNDS exports into a concise trend report with unresolved data gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Seed Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this seed-test result for [domain]. Report inbox, spam, and promotions placement by provider. Mark missing providers as NEEDS_INPUT: [results].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one post-send placement test

prompt_templates.title: Read Reputation Exports
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize these Gmail Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS exports for [domain]. State each reputation direction, complaint rate, and IP status: [exports].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Sends
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this campaign with the prior baseline. Name every provider-level placement or reputation regression and quantify each change: [current] [baseline].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Placement Snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [seed test], [Postmaster export], [SNDS export], and [baseline] for [profile]. Produce the placement verdict, evidence labels, SEND-S snapshot, and handoff.

output_examples.input: Gmail inbox 82%, promotions 15%, spam 3%; Outlook inbox 64%, junk 36%; Yahoo and Apple absent.
output: Gmail: 82% inbox, 15% promotions, 3% spam. Evidence: User-provided.
Outlook: 64% inbox and 36% junk. Placement is degrading.

output_examples.input: Current Gmail reputation is Medium with 0.14% spam rate. Prior reputation was High with 0.08% spam rate.
output_examples.output: Gmail regressed from High to Medium. Spam rate increased by 0.06 percentage points and crossed the 0.1% red line.

output_examples.input: SNDS shows IP 203.0.113.10 changed from green to yellow, while complaints rose from 0.05% to 0.12%.
output_examples.output: Microsoft placement risk increased. IP 203.0.113.10 changed from green to yellow, and complaints increased by 0.07 percentage points.

best_practices: Provide provider-level seed results and dashboard exports from the same send window.
Include a prior baseline with matching providers, domain, IP pool, and campaign profile.
Confirm all missing inputs and live actions before saving files or sending seed messages.
anti_patterns: Do not infer placement rates from delivery events or aggregate bounce data.
Do not treat missing provider data as a passing result.
Do not use this skill for authentication checks or a complete email quality score.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: Provide a seed-test result, relevant Postmaster or SNDS exports, and an optional prior-send baseline.

faq.question: Can it access Gmail Postmaster Tools automatically?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes exports or pasted results that you provide.

faq.question: Can it send a seed test?
faq.answer: It documents an optional Resend connector workflow. Dry-run is the default, and live sending requires explicit confirmation.

faq.question: What happens when a provider is missing?
faq.answer: The provider is marked NEEDS_INPUT. The skill does not assign a passing result without evidence.

faq.question: Does it check SPF, DKIM, and DMARC?
faq.answer: No. Use a pre-send deliverability check for authentication and configuration review.

faq.question: Does it calculate a complete email quality score?
faq.answer: No. It produces placement evidence and a SEND-S snapshot for a separate quality audit.
